[[/hcell]]
[[hcell colspan="3"]]
Wanda / Jinga
[[/hcell]]
[[/row]]
[[row]]
[[cell colspan="3"]]
A pet without real weakness, dubbed "Almighty Pet" in Japan. They have a rather efficient PP usage (even more efficient on Wanda), solid DPS, powerful normal attacks, high HP, high defense, and easy to use PAs. When in doubt of what pet to use, Wanda or Jinga is never a wrong choice.

14★ Wanda is more durable with higher HP and Def. 14★ Jinga has higher ATK and upgraded Jinga Assault, having a wider attack area and higher multiplier.

[[/cell]]
[[/row]]

Personality Description
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Enjoys Sun (晴れ好き) 112% damage during clear weather, does not work on EQs. Preferable if you use Jinga on regular quests.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Fervent (こんじょう) Small chance to endure damage that would otherwise killed it. Gains invulnerability when activated. Preferable on EQs, although Jinga itself is not easy to KO.
[[image http://capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Powerful (パワフル) 14★ only. Combines the effect of Enjoys Sun and Fervent, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

  • DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better
  • Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks, notated in A-B. A is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button, B is the number if you let the pet attack freely.
  • Overall DPS Rating: DPS rating when using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during best case scenario.

[[module css]]
.pet-personality, .weapon-potential{
margin-right: 0.2rem;
margin-top: -0.6rem;
height: 1.20rem;
}
.pet-skill, .skill-icon, .tech-icon{
max-height: 2em;
}
.pet-icon, .weapon-icon, .item-icon{
max-height: 4em;
}

.nowrap{
white-space: nowrap;
}

.cell-cont{
display: table-row;
background: var(color-generic-block);
border: 2px solid white;
font-size: calc(var(base-font-size) * 0.9);
}
.cell-icon,
.cell-desc {
display: table-cell;
vertical-align: middle;
padding: 4px;
}

.pet-pa-table .wiki-content-table {
margin-top: 0;
margin-bottom: 0;
}

.pet-pa-table .wiki-content-table th.text-center {
text-align:center;
}

.pet-pa-table-legend{
font-size: calc(var(base-font-size) * 0.9);
line-height: calc(var(base-line-height) * 0.6);
}

.pixelate{
image-rendering: pixelated;
}

.icon-144px{
height: 114px;
}

.pros-cons-list ul {
list-style: none;
-webkit-padding-start: 0;
}

.pros-cons-list.pros ul li:before {
content: "\f067";
}

.pros-cons-list.cons ul li:before {
content: "\f068";
}

.pros-cons-list ul li:before {
font-family: "FontAwesome";
margin-right: 0.5rem;
font-size: calc(var(--base-font-size) * 0.9);
}

[[/module]]
